row: Founded in 2004 by Grammy-winning singer-songwriter Emmylou Harris, Bonaparte’s Retreat is named in memory of one of Emmylou’s own beloved dogs. For 10 year, Bonaparte traveled "on the road" with her as she performed around the world. When he died suddenly in 2002, Emmylou was heartbroken. But her personal loss became the genesis of something remarkable. Emmylou established Bonaparte’s Retreat, a 501(c)3 nonprofit dog rescue organization in Nashville and dedicated to providing nurturing care for adoptable dogs when their allotted time at a shelter has elapsed. Our mission is to prevent these wonderful animals from being euthanized and to adopt them into permanent, loving homes.
